children: Invesco reported preliminary month‑end assets under management of $2,562.1 billion and $27.6 billion of net long‑term inflows for August.
Preliminary AUM at August 31, 2026: $2,562.1 billion, up 4.7% vs. July month‑end.
Net long‑term inflows for August totaled $27.6 billion, supporting growth in AUM.
Money market net inflows were $35.8 billion, a significant contributor to monthly inflows.
Favorable market returns increased AUM by $49.0 billion; FX added $2.7 billion to AUM.
Preliminary quarter‑to‑date average total AUM: $2,492.2 billion; average active AUM: $1,236.6 billion.
